covered_report_window.description: U.S.-listed companies reporting after the U.S. market close on Monday, August 17, 2026, plus companies reporting before the U.S. market open on Tuesday, August 18, 2026.

market_context_summary: U.S. equities were near record levels, but the 10-year Treasury yield was around 4.70%, inflation remained above 3%, oil and gasoline prices were elevated by the U.S.-Iran conflict, and July housing-starts and industrial-production releases were scheduled for Tuesday morning. This mix raises the hurdle for long-duration growth stocks and housing-sensitive consumer names.

methodology.disparity_formula: Average of (direction-score range divided by 2) and reversal-risk range, rounded to the nearest integer.
methodology.lessons_review: No new method change. Existing key-metric-first, premium-growth priced-in penalty, and low-bar reversal-risk rules were applied.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Arc'teryx and Salomon momentum plus prior margin expansion support upside, provided Q2 clears the raised growth bar without a tariff or inventory-quality setback.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Company Q2 guidance called for 22%-24% reported revenue growth, about 59.5% gross margin, and 6%-7% operating margin; public estimates cluster near $0.10-$0.11 EPS and roughly $1.0 billion revenue.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Arc'teryx omni-comp durability, Salomon softgoods acceleration, and another full-year guidance raise.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Growth deceleration, 33% inventory growth, tariff pressure, or a merely in-line quarter against elevated brand expectations.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Public event estimates indicated about an 8.9% implied move; the stock was down about 5.6% year to date in a late-July snapshot, reducing but not eliminating a sell-the-news risk.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: The company raised 2026 revenue, margin, and EPS guidance after Q1; current public EPS estimates are near the low double-digit-cent range for Q2.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Weak transaction trends and 4.70% Treasury yields make a convincing home-improvement demand inflection difficult, even if revenue and EPS land near consensus.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Consensus is about $4.73 EPS and $47.2-$47.3 billion revenue; fiscal 2026 guidance remains 0%-2% comparable-sales growth and adjusted EPS growth of 0%-4%.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: U.S. comps accelerate, Pro demand offsets DIY softness, and management preserves or lifts guidance.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Transactions stay negative, the second-half recovery narrative softens, or housing and tariff commentary weakens the guide.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Public event estimates indicated roughly a 4.2% implied move; the stock's prior underperformance and moderate valuation create meaningful relief-rally risk.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Oppenheimer's preview was below Street at $4.66 EPS and questioned expected second-half demand improvement; broader consensus remained near $4.73.

ranked_companies.expected_driver: Transaction margin dollars and credit losses
ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Rapid GMV and revenue growth plus improving profitability support relief upside, but credit-cost quality and a previously soft Q2 guide make the event highly reversible.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Company Q2 guidance was $35.5-$36.5 billion GMV, $960 million-$1.0 billion revenue, $375-$395 million transaction margin dollars, and $30-$50 million adjusted operating income.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: GMV clears guidance, credit losses stay near 0.55% of GMV, and transaction-margin conversion beats the cautious guide.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Fair Financing growth raises loss or funding costs, or Q3 commentary fails to validate durable margins.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Public event estimates suggested about a 15% implied move; social chatter was bullish and cited call open interest, while the stock fell 6.8% intraday before the report.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Q1 beat on growth and profitability, but contemporaneous reporting said the Q2 GMV and revenue outlook was below analyst expectations.

pass_outputs.key_metric: Credit losses as a percent of GMV

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Record iron-ore execution and strong copper pricing are offset by a well-flagged FY27 copper decline, Jansen impairment, and a stock already near cycle highs.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: BHP pre-disclosed 1.953 million tonnes of FY26 copper, FY27 copper guidance of 1.65-1.80 million tonnes, about $9 billion net debt, and an approximately $2.3 billion Jansen impairment.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Final dividend, unit costs, or FY27 capital allocation beat expectations while copper pricing remains supportive.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Lower FY27 copper volumes, Jansen costs, Samarco cash effects, or a conservative payout dominate record iron-ore output.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: BHP ADR had risen about 75% over one year and was near its 52-week high; a July options snapshot showed a put/call volume ratio around 1.63.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Post-operational-review commentary was neutral overall, with the softer FY27 copper number the main negative; the final dividend remained the open swing factor.

ranked_companies.expected_driver: AI Cloud growth versus ad decline
ranked_companies.key_risk_to_call: AI relief rally from a low bar
ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: AI Cloud acceleration is real, but a steep online-marketing decline and rising cloud costs leave only a marginal downside edge with substantial relief-rally risk.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Public estimates were around RMB12.1 EPS and RMB33.1 billion revenue, while other calendar estimates were lower; Q1 online-marketing revenue fell 22% year over year.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: AI Cloud sustains exceptional growth, marketing stabilizes, and Apollo Go or AI-app monetization improves the forward narrative.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Marketing contraction remains severe and cloud cost growth dilutes the benefit of AI infrastructure revenue.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Public event estimates suggested about a 5.8% implied move; the ADS was well below its January 2026 high, increasing relief-rally risk.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Estimate sources disagreed on headline EPS, lowering precision; the higher-quality operating signal is whether 79% Q1 AI Cloud growth persists against the ad decline.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: AI-optical demand remains powerful, but consensus has moved above prior guidance and a roughly 50-times trailing P/E plus extreme option pricing leave no clean directional edge.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Public consensus was about $3.93 EPS and $1.31 billion revenue, above prior company guidance of $3.72-$3.87 and $1.25-$1.29 billion.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Datacom ramps drive a decisive beat and fiscal Q1 guidance validates sustained AI-optical growth.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: A merely solid quarter, customer concentration, or conservative forward guidance triggers another valuation reset.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: A late-July options snapshot showed an unusually large roughly 23% weekly implied move and high IV; the prior earnings reaction was down about 8% despite strong growth.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Consensus rose above the company's May guidance, increasing the real beat threshold; public targets remained bullish but dispersion was wide.

pass_outputs.key_metric: Revenue beat quality versus raised bar

detailed_company_sections.bull_case: Pro demand, big-ticket sales, and guidance relief trigger a de-risked rally.
detailed_company_sections.bear_case: Weak comps plus softer second-half guidance produce a larger-than-implied decline.

detailed_company_sections.bull_case: Credit remains stable and transaction-margin conversion drives a sharp relief rally.
detailed_company_sections.bear_case: Credit/funding costs or guidance overwhelm GMV growth.

detailed_company_sections.bull_case: Dividend and capital allocation beat elevated expectations.
detailed_company_sections.bear_case: Copper volume, Jansen, and Samarco cash issues dominate.

detailed_company_sections.bull_case: AI growth and monetization cause a low-bar relief rally.
detailed_company_sections.bear_case: Ad weakness and cloud costs deepen the earnings decline.

detailed_company_sections.bear_case: A conservative outlook triggers valuation compression.

timing_exclusions.reason: Official company announcement schedules fiscal Q4 2026 results for September 1, 2026, not August 17.
Confirmed reporting date is later in August; August 18 calendar entry was stale.
